what_it_does: FaSTCC accelerates sparse tensor contractions (a core operation in scientific computing and machine learning) on CPUs by optimizing how loops are arranged and ordered. The tool analyzes different loop orderings to understand which patterns minimize memory accesses and storage requirements, then automatically selects tile sizes and decides whether to accumulate results in dense or sparse arrays. It uses probability-based modeling to make these decisions and parallel execution via hashing for efficient computation.
